The City publishes, but not on its website.
Both city domains (elsegundo.gov, elsegundo.org) refuse automated access (HTTP 403, live read). The City's GIS lives on ArcGIS Online: organisation
, live read), and a Hub site, "City of El Segundo GIS Hub" (
, live read). The server holds more than the catalogue lists, as in Hamilton (pattern SP-010).
Los Angeles County has two Hub front doors over largely one catalogue.

data.lacounty.gov lists 1,109 datasets and egis-lacounty.hub.arcgis.com lists 966; 950 identifiers are shared (live read). Same pattern as Brantford (SP-001). Many licence fields are raw HTML (SP-002 analogue).
The county parcel layer can likely be narrowed to the city by attribute.
The Public Works parcel layer carries
and use codes (field names, live read). Whether
matches the city limit is a stage C question.
Infrastructure has rich, open, non-city holders.

The electric utility (Southern California Edison) publishes 47 datasets including substations, transmission circuits and grid hosting capacity (live read). Federal transport statistics publish the national rail network, ports and freight flows (142 datasets, live read). The state energy commission publishes power plants and transmission lines (202 datasets, live read).

The state toxic-substances download page and the state water board's GeoTracker download page both return 403 (live read). The toxic-sites export is also published on the California State Geoportal, an official second door. The Sanitation Districts' maps page returns 403. FEMA's flood hazard service did not answer at all (connection failure, twice); to re-check.
a Colombian health agency layer, "Reclamos en Salud Segundo Semestre 2024" ("second half-year"), appears in an ArcGIS Online search for "El Segundo" (SP-003).
on the City's server looks like fire-department pre-planning for hazardous sites. Flagged sensitive (hold rule H6): not profiled, not published.
Tiers: federal, state, regional (SCAG and special districts), county, city, special-purpose bodies and utilities.

5. Patterns seen again, and new ones
SP-001 (two Hub front doors over one organisation): seen again, Los Angeles County.
SP-003 (same-name decoy): seen again, a Spanish-language layer matching "Segundo".
SP-004 (portal root refuses access): seen again, the City's own domains, the Sanitation Districts, two state download pages.
SP-010 (server holds more than the catalogue): seen again, 73 services against 55 Hub items.
a city whose website refuses automated access while its ArcGIS Online organisation is open.
Search ArcGIS Online by name before concluding a city publishes nothing.
California's investor-owned utilities publish grid hosting capacity, substations and circuits openly
(required by the state utilities commission). Look for the utility's distribution planning portal in every California city.
